correctness.rationale: A unique-first-occurrence decomposition proves the multivariate rational hitting generating function. Its letter-marker derivative yields the exact integrable expected-ratio difference. For the largest nonzero border difference, shorter-prefix changes obey a Lipschitz bound, and 1−t^2/(1−t)^2>0 for 0<t<1/2. This establishes pairwise signs for all q, lengths and targets; numerical automaton comparisons independently corroborate.

value.rationale: The exact total weak ranking of expected stopped letter proportions for every alphabet and every target is a structurally motivated statistic of sequence-pattern first detection.
